lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Commander, is that you?
Who is this?

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: I am the researcher in charge of N102.
Anne.
Right?

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Yes, right, Anne.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: To be frank, I hope you can stop approaching her.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: It will negatively affect my experiment.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: If the experiment fails,

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: I will lose my job at Missilis.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: You wouldn't want someone so gifted to be out of a job, would you?

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: I heard that you're a very kind-hearted individual.
Experiment?

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: I write down the contents of N102's notebook every morning.
Anne.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: I write down the contents of Anne's notebook every morning.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: You know, just some simple things.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: What she'll eat, what she'll win at the claw machine, what items she'll purchase...

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Although the content changes every day,

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: fabricating it all is much harder than you can imagine, haha!
Do not laugh.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Fine, pretend you didn't see the "haha" then.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: You know that Anne's memory is erased every day, right?

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: I brainwash her and ask her to check the content of the notebook every morning when she wakes up.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: After Anne reads whatever is written inside the notebook,

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: she will treat those writings as her own memories.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Isn't that fascinating?
What exactly is the point of this experiment?

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: to what extent NIMPH can act autonomously with current technology,

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: We also are interested

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: in how much a Nikke's memory can be controlled using words alone.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: All signs point to the experiment being a resounding success.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: I hope that you will not interfere any further.
What will happen once the experiment is over?

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: I don't know what will happen to Anne.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: But what will happen to me is obvious.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Promotion,

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: huge rewards,

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: and social recognition.
And to accomplish that, you're willing to sacrifice Anne.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Whatever do you mean by 'sacrifice'?

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: This is the entire reason why she was manufactured.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: When you bite into a hamburger, you don't feel like you've 'sacrificed' the cow, do you?

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: It's the same thing.
Where are you now?

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Hehehe, what's the matter?

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: You wanna come and beat me to a pulp?

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Don't be like that. Besides, I'm no fighter.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: The only reason

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: I'm even telling you all this is because you're apparently such a kind person.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Anyway, she won't remember any of this coming tomorrow morning. Why do you treat her so nicely?

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Don't be like that. It's just a waste of time.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: You'll be putting me in an awkward position.
I will create memories for Anne.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Is that so? Don't waste your time.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Or would you like to become more acquainted with our legal team over atMissilis?
Do your worst.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: My goodness,

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: what a good little boy scout you are.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: It pains me to do so, but if this is how it's going to be, then you're about to enter a world of pain, my friend.
We'll see who comes out on top.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 9s2ba2
lines.text: We'll see.
